database_summary: A read-only SQLite snapshot of Magic: The Gathering card data. The central table is 'cards' (card-level descriptive attributes, one row per card printing/uuid). Supporting tables provide localized text ('foreign_data'), legality statuses per format ('legalities'), set-level metadata ('sets' and translations), and rulings (official clarifications). Row counts show many-to-one relationships from foreign_data, legalities, and rulings back to cards (these are event/history or per-language/per-format records). No time-series facts with measurement units are present; most tables contain descriptive attributes or enumerated/status rows.

accepted.name: cards_base
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  artist,
  asciiName,
  availability,
  borderColor,
  cardKingdomFoilId,
  cardKingdomId,
  colorIdentity,
  colorIndicator,
  colors,
  convertedManaCost,
  duelDeck,
  edhrecRank,
  faceConvertedManaCost,
  faceName,
  flavorName,
  flavorText,
  frameEffects,
  frameVersion,
  hand,
  hasAlternativeDeckLimit,
  hasContentWarning,
  hasFoil,
  hasNonFoil,
  isAlternative,
  isFullArt,
  isOnlineOnly,
  isOversized,
  isPromo,
  isReprint,
  isReserved,
  isStarter,
  isStorySpotlight,
  isTextless,
  isTimeshifted,
  keywords,
  layout,
  leadershipSkills,
  life,
  loyalty,
  manaCost,
  mcmId,
  mcmMetaId,
  mtgArenaId,
  mtgjsonV4Id,
  mtgoFoilId,
  mtgoId,
  multiverseId,
  name,
  number,
  originalReleaseDate,
  originalText,
  originalType,
  otherFaceIds,
  power,
  printings,
  promoTypes,
  purchaseUrls,
  rarity,
  scryfallId,
  scryfallIllustrationId,
  scryfallOracleId,
  setCode,
  side,
  subtypes,
  supertypes,
  tcgplayerProductId,
  text,
  toughness,
  type,
  types,
  uuid,
  variations,
  watermark
FROM cards
WHERE 1=1
accepted.description: Normalized projection of the cards table exposing core descriptive attributes and measures per card printing (one row per cards.id). Use this when you need a stable, small set of columns from cards for joins, filtering, or aggregations. | Use for: card-level filters and counts (by rarity, setCode, colors, convertedManaCost); joining cards to sets, legalities, foreign_data, or rulings; sampling card attributes for downstream aggregates

accepted.name: cards_by_set
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  setCode,
  COUNT(*) AS card_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rarity IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cards_with_rarity,
  AVG(convertedManaCost) AS avg_convertedManaCost,
  MIN(convertedManaCost) AS min_convertedManaCost,
  MAX(convertedManaCost) AS max_convertedManaCost
FROM cards
GROUP BY setCode
accepted.description: Aggregated measures of cards per set (one row per setCode) providing counts and summary measures useful for set-level reporting. | Use for: Compare set sizes and mana-cost distributions across sets; Filter sets by average converted mana cost or number of cards

accepted.name: cards_latest_ruling
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.uuid,
  r.date,
  r.text
FROM rulings r
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT uuid, MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM rulings
  GROUP BY uuid
) mr ON r.uuid = mr.uuid AND r.date = mr.max_date
accepted.description: Latest ruling text per card uuid (one row per uuid) by most recent ruling.date. Use when you need the most recent ruling for each card. | Use for: Attach the latest ruling to each card for display or analysis; Filter cards that have a ruling or examine recent rulings across sets

accepted.name: card_legalities_pivot
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid,
  GROUP_CONCAT(l.format || ':' || l.status, '|') AS legalities_summary
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid
accepted.description: One-row-per-card pivot of legalities statuses across formats. Produces one row per cards.uuid with legalities concatenated per format into 'format_status' columns. Use when you want a denormalized snapshot of format legality per card. Note: includes only formats present in the data as dynamic columns are not possible in static SQL; this CTE produces a generic representation with format and status concatenated as rows converted to text mapping column. | Use for: Filter cards that are legal/illegal in a given format by searching legalities_summary; Export compact per-card legality snapshots for frontend display

accepted.name: cards_with_set_info
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.uuid,
  c.name,
  c.setCode,
  c.rarity,
  c.convertedManaCost,
  s.code AS code,
  s.name AS name,
  s.releaseDate,
  s.type AS type,
  s.block
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
accepted.description: Denormalized join of cards to their set metadata (one row per card.id). Use when you need card attributes alongside set-level fields like releaseDate or name. | Use for: List cards with their set release dates and metadata; Analyze rarity distributions by set releaseDate or block

accepted.name: foreign_translations_by_card
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  uuid,
  language,
  multiverseid,
  name,
  text,
  flavorText,
  type
FROM foreign_data
WHERE 1=1
accepted.description: One-row-per foreign_data row (card translation) projecting language, name, and text. Use to filter or join translations by language or multiverseid. | Use for: Retrieve translations in a particular language for display; Join translations to cards to compare localized vs original text

accepted.name: sets_with_translations
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.id AS id,
  s.code AS code,
  s.name AS name,
  s.releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  st.language AS language,
  st.translation AS translation
FROM sets s
LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
accepted.description: Join of sets to their translations producing one row per translation (one row per set_translations.id). Use when you need set metadata together with translated names. | Use for: Show set names in different languages alongside set release dates; Filter sets by translation presence or specific language
